129838: Richeh is a young witch in training and a disciple of Qifrey. She wants to keep her magic essentially "pure" and unchanged and resents having to do what others tell her to do. Richeh specializes in crystal magic, particularly in creating transparent crystal ribbons.
129839: Tetia is a young witch in training at Qifrey's Atelier. She loves clouds and dreams of creating the perfect cloud magic. She's perpetually energetic and has a habit of thanking people for thanking her.
129840: She is a young girl who becomes an apprentice witch under the witch Qifrey after her initial accidental use of forbidden magic turned her mother to crystal. She hopes to search the Tower of Books for the book containing the magic, in order to reverse its effects on her mother.
129841: Qifrey is a witch and Coco's teacher. He runs an atelier and currently has four disciples. He is a caring teacher who patiently teaches his students magic.
129842: Agott is a witch in training and Qifrey's student. She belongs to the famous Arkrome house, who have served as librarians at the Tower of Books for generations.
137972: He is a witch and serves as the Watchful Eye for Qifrey's atelier. He has a gruff way of speaking but his magic is often described as "warm". He has created a lot of magical items, such as the Glowstone Path, the Snugstone and the Searneedle Wand.
137973: Alaira is a senior witch who lives at the Witch Auditorium. She is friends with Qifrey.
158680: Nolnoa's young assistant in the shop. He suffers from argentosis, a rare sight condition which makes him effectively colorblind and thus initially unable to use magic because certain effects rely on inks differentiated by their color.
158681: Nolnoa is an old witch who runs a magic shop called The Starry Sword with his grandson Tartah in the town of Kalhn.
158683: A member of the Knights Moralis and the leader of a squad of five. A strict and serious individual, he is pretty stern and does not care about trivial things such as his birthday.
158684: He is a nervous apprentice witch studying under Kukrow. Euini is a very anxious witch who worries about his own abilities and is very aware of his own faults; he confesses that he is most comfortable practicing magic when there isn't an audience watching him.
163622: Iguin is the Brimmed Hat Witch who sold a book of forbidden magic to Coco. Their motivation is somewhat unknown, but it has something to do with Coco. They appear to be incredibly powerful, possessing magic that is beyond the scope of normal witches.
236474: He is a young boy with dark skin, dark eyes, and long dark hair. He is occasionally drawn with sharp and noticeable canines. After an incident that left his legs unusable, he also uses a sealchair.
249347: Dagda is a traveling minstrel. He appears alongside the boy Coustas who is like a son to him.
253736: Member of the Knights Moralis. He works directly under Easthies.
331253: Richeh's older brother and an apprentice witch. Riliphin is a reserved and quiet young man. He has a strong aversion to areas with a large number of people, and prefers quiet places.
331259: Sasaran, also known as the "Empty Cloak Witch" and the "very embodiment of forbidden magic" is a mysterious member of the Brimmed Cap Group.
331260: A member of a species called the brushbuddy. A small creature with fur resembling a paintbrush. It possesses a natural instinct to gather wherever it catches the scent of Magic Ink. Friendly and affectionate, it has grown quite attached to Coco and the members of the Atelier.
331261: Coco's mother is a middle-aged woman who owns her own tailoring shop. She raised Coco by herself after her husband died.
331274: Galga is a member of the Knights Moralis.
331279: He is the disparaging teacher of Euini.
